value: Up to 1 hour of energy conservation (optional substitution within the 6 hours)
Licensed electricians: 16 hours per two-year cycle under electrician CE program
Licensed plumbers: 12 hours per two-year cycle under plumber CE program

topical_requirements.quote: a licensed electrician shall complete 16 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section; a licensed plumber shall complete 12 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section; and a licensed elevator mechanic shall complete eight hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section.

available.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state/district/territory with a similar scope of practice, have at least one year of experience under that license, and the license must be in good standing. Division evaluates education, credentialing examination, experience, and skills for competency.
requirements.quote: the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing a person who is not licensed to perform work on a project when licensure is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project, unless the person is an employee of a person licensed under this chapter for wages; and is not required to be licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to directly supervise an apprentice under one's supervision or exceeding the allowed number of apprentices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor in the electrical trade or plumbing trade, journeyman plumber, residential journeyman plumber, journeyman electrician, master electrician, or residential electrician, failing to directly supervise an apprentice under one's supervision or exceeding the number of apprentices one is allowed to have under the contractor's supervision

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving funds for a project and exercising unauthorized control over them by failing to pay amounts due to persons who performed work or furnished materials.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor or representing oneself to be a contractor, receiving any funds in payment for a specific project from an owner or any other person, which funds are to pay for work performed or materials and services furnished for that specific project, and after receiving the funds to exercise unauthorized control over the funds by failing to pay the full amounts due and payable

definition_quote.value: 'Construction trade' means any trade or occupation involving: (a)(i) construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, wrecking or demolition, addition to, or improvement of any building, highway, road, railroad, dam, bridge, structure, excavation or other project, development, or improvement to other than personal property; and (ii) constructing, remodeling, or repairing a manufactured home or mobile home as defined in Section 15A-1-302; or (b) installation or repair of a residential or commercial natural gas appliance or combustion system.
